_source: Mined read-only from the zeldaret/tww decompilation at Z:/memRip/sources/tww and the ripped GZLE01 (Wind Waker USA) disc data at Z:/3d ripper/out/rip/GZLE01. Chapter 2: the pirates carry Link to the Forsaken Fortress, he is caught, thrown into the sea, and meets the King of Red Lions at Windfall. Same conventions as ww_story_outset.json. Event names come from each stage's Stage.arc/event_list.dat and from the stage.dzs EVNT table (dumped by tools/ww_story_mine.py). Triggers come from stage.dzs / room.dzr placement chunks: PLYR spawn points (params>>24 = index into the stage's EVNT table -> auto-started event) and TagEv volumes (params: >>24 EVNT index, >>16&0xFF switch2, >>8&0xFF switch, &0xFF daTag_Event_c::Action_e; rot.z = required event bit). The chapter's checkpoints are stated outright by the game in dComIfGs_setGameStartStage (src/d/d_com_inf_game.cpp:1294-1311), which is the strongest evidence in this file: it lists, in order, which event bit sends a continuing save to which stage and spawn. Event-bit ids are authoritative numbers; the UNK_xxxx names are placeholders invented by the decomp team (include/d/d_save_event_flag.inc says so itself), so numeric ids are used here.

_checkpoints.source: src/d/d_com_inf_game.cpp:1294-1311 dComIfGs_setGameStartStage, l_checkData[] - walked in order, the FIRST bit that is set wins

order.stage: (none - resume wherever the file was saved)
order.meaning: Link has boarded the King of Red Lions at least once: the game is open
met the King of Red Lions
the infiltration cutscene is done - Link is inside the fortress grounds
Link has been launched at the fortress
the ship has left Outset (set by the departure step of ww_story_outset.json)

0x2401.meaning: The pirate ship has left Outset with Link aboard. Raised by the departure step of the Outset chapter; it is what sends a continuing save to A_umikz.

0x0808.meaning: Link has been launched at the Forsaken Fortress by the pirates' catapult. Sends a continuing save to MajyuE spawn 18. No onEventBit call for it exists in src/, so it is raised by event data (the launch demo), the same way 0x0520 is in the Outset chapter.

0x0802.meaning: Tetra's dock conversation on Outset ('yuukaigo') has finished.

0x0804.meaning: Tetra's 'ooi' call at the fortress has finished. On that event ending she also moves herself to (-37692, 2200, 8016) facing -0x5C72, ready for the infiltration.

0x0801.meaning: The infiltration cutscene ('majyuu_shinnyuu') is done. Tetra deletes herself when it is set, the fortress stage type changes behaviour, and a continuing save resumes at MajyuE spawn 0.

0x0340.meaning: Gates the SerchLook1 trigger volume in MajyuE (the searchlight look). Read only from placement data - no reference to it exists in src/, so what raises it is event data.

0x0F80.meaning: MET_KORL: Link has met the King of Red Lions. Raised by the event manager the moment the event named MEETSHISHIOH starts - not when it ends.

0x2A08.meaning: RODE_KORL: Link has boarded the King of Red Lions. Once it is set the continue table stops forcing a stage and the file resumes wherever it was saved - the point at which the game becomes open.

Zl1.name: Tetra
Zl1.index_rule: field_0x84A is a state byte; when it is >= 3 the event index is field_0x84A - 3 and the actor calls fopAcM_orderOtherEventId (src/d/actor/d_a_npc_zl1.cpp:1059-1069). Same shape as Aryll's m850.

how_each_is_ordered.yuukaigo: demo_4 sets field_0x84A = 3 with no distance test at all - the copy placed for that story state orders it as it spawns (src/d/actor/d_a_npc_zl1.cpp:2259)
how_each_is_ordered.majyuu_shinnyuu: demo_3: deletes Tetra outright if 0x0801 is already set, otherwise field_0x764.abs(player pos) < mPrmTbl.field_28 = 200.0f sets field_0x84A = 5 (src/d/actor/d_a_npc_zl1.cpp:2243-2257)

trigger.detail: The continue table sends a save with 0x2401 set to stage "A_umikz", room 0, start code 204 (src/d/d_com_inf_game.cpp:1309). A_umikz is the sea during the pirate ship's run to the Forsaken Fortress; its EVNT table holds a single entry, "dummy", and none of its 71 event scripts is story-specific, so the ride itself is scenery plus the ship actor - there is no event to order here.

steps.notes: Stage name per gcrip/data/ww_stages.py: "Sea During Pirate Ship Ride To Forsaken Fortress".

trigger.detail: The pirates fire Link over the wall. The continue table sends a save with 0x0808 set to MajyuE room 0, start code 18 (src/d/d_com_inf_game.cpp:1308), so 0x0808 is what the launch raises. No onEventBit for 0x0808 exists in src/, so it comes from event data, the way 0x0520 does in the Outset chapter.

steps.notes: The launch demo itself has not been identified; MajyuE's EVNT table has no entry for it and none of its scripts is obviously the catapult.

trigger.detail: MajyuE spawn 9 at (716, -500, -3691) carries EVNT index 1 = "Go_00", the arrival camera for the fortress exterior.

steps.notes: MajyuE's EVNT table (22): StartCamera, Go_00, TowerLook2, TowerLook3, TowerLook4, TowerLook4, enemy_appear, TowerLook4, push, FIRST_HINT, MAJU_SHINNYU, SerchLook1, Goal, TowerLook5..9, TL10, TL11, TL12, MJ_push2.

trigger.detail: Three more spawns auto-play a camera look at the tower: spawn 6 -> TowerLook3 at (-2370, 702, -1921), spawn 10 -> TowerLook2 at (617, 1745, -7959), spawn 15 -> TowerLook4 at (3390, 710, -1625). Six further TagEv volumes on layer -1 order TowerLook5..TowerLook9 and TL10 as Link crosses the courtyard, and three volumes around (361/940/-116, 1428, ~1960) all order TL11 with switch 226.

steps.notes: Pure camera flavour - none of these carries an event bit. Grouped as one step because they are the same beat: the fortress tower looming over the courtyard.

trigger.detail: Tetra orders it herself. daNpc_Zl1_c::demo_2 runs chk_areaIN(l_HIO.mPrmTbl.field_24 = 200.0f XZ, 100.0f dy, any angle) and sets field_0x84A = 4, so the event index is 4 - 3 = 1 = l_evn_tbl[1] = "ooi". No TagEv is involved.

steps.notes: When the event ends she moves to (-37692, 2200, 8016) facing -0x5C72 and raises 0x0804 (event_proc case 1).

trigger.detail: Also Tetra: daNpc_Zl1_c::demo_3 deletes her outright if 0x0801 is already set, otherwise field_0x764.abs(player pos) < l_HIO.mPrmTbl.field_28 = 200.0f sets field_0x84A = 5, so the event index is 2 = l_evn_tbl[2] = "majyuu_shinnyuu". MajyuE's EVNT table entry 10 is MAJU_SHINNYU, the demo name for maju_shinnyu.stb.

steps.notes: 0x0801 is the chapter's real checkpoint: with it set, a continuing save resumes at MajyuE spawn 0 and Tetra is gone.

trigger.detail: A TagEv at (-2787, 1306, 1202) with switch 25 orders EVNT entry 11 = "SerchLook1", gated on event bit 0x0340 in its rot.z. It is the only gated volume in the stage.

steps.notes: Nothing in src/ raises 0x0340, so what turns the searchlight look on is event data. The stage also carries Search_Light_Find, Search_Light_Find_With_Barrel, Search_Light_Find_Wall and Search_Light_Up scripts, which is the caught-by-the-searchlight flow.

trigger.detail: A TagEv at (3253, 1413, -3264) with switch 2 orders EVNT entry 8 = "push"; a second at (4627, 2858, -701) with switch 13 orders entry 21 = "MJ_push2".

steps.notes: The barrel Link hides in and pushes across the searchlight yard.

trigger.detail: majroom spawns 0, 1 and 18 all sit at (-2634, 2215, 8658) and carry EVNT index 0 = "kankin1" (the cell block), so arriving in the cells auto-plays it. Room arrivals also auto-play Go_00 (room 2 spawn 15), Go_01 (room 3 spawn 10) and Go_02 (room 3 spawn 9). CORRECTION: an earlier draft claimed four AttTag volumes with switch 3 also order kankin1 - they do not. AttTag / AttTagB are a different actor (fpcNm_Tag_Attention_e) and carry NO event index: d_a_tag_attention.h:55-72 decodes only type = (params >> 8) & 0x3 and swSave = params & 0xFF. An earlier draft of this file read them as TagEv volumes; corrected 2026-08-22.

steps.notes: majroom's EVNT table (9): kankin1, Go_00, Go_01, Go_02, FIRST_HINT2, FIRST_HINT3, DoorLook1, DoorLook2, moro_cam. 'kankin' is imprisonment - these are the cells Link searches for Aryll. The 0x0801 requirement is inferred from the chapter order, not from a gate in the data. The four AttTag volumes in rooms 0/1/2/4 are attention markers (type 3, swSave 255), not triggers.

trigger.detail: Two TagEv volumes in room 3 with switch 224 order DoorLook1 at (3246, 1689, -5953) and DoorLook2 at (-206, 1696, -5902).

steps.notes: Camera looks at the doors Link has to reach.

trigger.detail: A TagEv at (-2376, 728, 3800) with switch 6 orders EVNT entry 8 = "moro_cam".

steps.notes: 'moro' is the Moblin (mo2). The stage also carries a MOZO_CAM script that is not in the EVNT table, so nothing in the placement data orders it.

trigger.detail: Mjtower's EVNT table has exactly one entry, FIND_SISTER, and spawn 16 at (2721, 4059, -4424) carries index 0, so arriving at the top of the tower auto-plays it. The baked cutscene find_sister.stb is 2985 frames.

steps.notes: Link finds Aryll in the cell at the top of the tower - and the Helmaroc King finds him. Mjtower's only other story script is AHEAHE, the shared boss-defeat event every boss stage carries. find_sister.stb raises 0x2580 when it starts - event data PACKAGE PLAY EventFlag, raised on cutscene start by dEvDtStaff_c::specialProcPackage (src/d/d_event_data.cpp:797-800). find_sister.stb raises 0x2580 when it starts - event data PACKAGE PLAY EventFlag, raised on cutscene start by dEvDtStaff_c::specialProcPackage (src/d/d_event_data.cpp:797-800). find_sister.stb raises 0x2580 when it starts - event data PACKAGE PLAY EventFlag, raised on cutscene start by dEvDtStaff_c::specialProcPackage (src/d/d_event_data.cpp:797-800).

trigger.detail: The Helmaroc drops Link into the sea and he washes up at Windfall. sea room 11 spawn 200 at (10449, 5, -202313) carries EVNT index 2 = MEETSHISHIOH, so arriving there auto-plays the King of Red Lions' introduction. The event manager raises MET_KORL (0x0F80) the moment that event STARTS, not when it ends (src/d/d_event_manager.cpp:596-600).

steps.notes: 'shishioh' is lion king. With MET_KORL set the continue table sends a save to sea room 11 (Windfall) start code 128. meetshishioh.stb raises 0x2E01 when it starts - event data PACKAGE PLAY EventFlag, raised on cutscene start by dEvDtStaff_c::specialProcPackage (src/d/d_event_data.cpp:797-800). meetshishioh.stb raises 0x2E01 when it starts - event data PACKAGE PLAY EventFlag, raised on cutscene start by dEvDtStaff_c::specialProcPackage (src/d/d_event_data.cpp:797-800). meetshishioh.stb raises 0x2E01 when it starts - event data PACKAGE PLAY EventFlag, raised on cutscene start by dEvDtStaff_c::specialProcPackage (src/d/d_event_data.cpp:797-800).

trigger.detail: Boarding the King of Red Lions raises RODE_KORL (0x2A08) in daShip_c (src/d/actor/d_a_ship.cpp:1570). The ship actor itself gates on it (line 599), and the player checks it before allowing sea behaviour on a SEA-type stage (src/d/actor/d_a_player_main.cpp:10872).

steps.notes: This is the end of the chapter and the point the game opens up: once 0x2A08 is set the continue table stops forcing a stage and the file resumes wherever it was saved.
